summary: Robert F. Kennedy Jr., son of Robert F. Kennedy, was an environmental lawyer and became a prominent vaccine skeptic. He ran for the 2024 Democratic nomination, switched to an independent bid in 2023, and in August 2024 suspended it and endorsed Trump. The Senate confirmed him as health and human services secretary 52–48 in February 2025.
